name: io.github.nyingimaina/lite-commander
title: Lite Commander
description: Start, stop and watch a project's local dev terminals (servers, databases, shells), run one-off commands and use git, with cheap plain-text output. Windows desktop app plus the lcmd command line.

_meta.install: Run the installer (it adds lcmd to PATH and can register the server with detected LLM tools), then `lcmd mcp install`.
